nodes.label: Function Node
nodes.rationale: Use a function node (deterministic code) whenever the step does not need judgment.

nodes.label: Long-Term Memory (memory service)
nodes.rationale: Memory read runs in a before-model callback so preferences load before the agent reasons; memory write runs in an after-agent callback saving a session summary. Facts are consolidated and deduplicated, not duplicated.

nodes.label: Amplitude + Statsig (agent analytics, flags, experimentation)
nodes.rationale: Amplitude was called 'a little hard' by the team.

nodes.label: Judging (no published criteria)
nodes.rationale: The 'three sponsor products minimum' mentioned in the brainstorm is unverified; confirm with organizers.

nodes.label: Graph Workflow (nodes and edges)
nodes.rationale: More reliable than a pure multi-agent system because the order of work is fixed by the graph instead of decided by agents at runtime. Start small with a single agent and tools, then move the process into a graph.

nodes.label: Long-Running Tool
nodes.rationale: In production use a cron job, scheduler or watcher instead of a polling loop.

nodes.label: Persistent Database
nodes.rationale: Required to keep state across server crashes and long waits.
